shizhan.prompt_core: Preserve the premium near-black and deep-crimson technology background, layered warm paper, dark-red backing paper, thin red rules, restrained brush accents and hard-edged editorial AI-testing mood.

3:4.composition: Exact 3:4 portrait. Anchor the presenter at lower-left at roughly 34–40% of canvas width. Keep the paper across the center and right. Use 3–4 compact title lines.

4:3.composition: Exact 4:3 landscape. Anchor the presenter at lower-left at roughly 28–34% of canvas width. Keep the paper expanded horizontally. Use 2–3 compact title lines.
